==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I have discovered a magical closet. It appears small on the outside. In reality it is as large as a warehouse on the inside.

Inside of the closet I have a large table for hosting parties. I also have a VR headset that I use for virtual skateboarding. But the strangest thing I have in my closet is a Human Making Machine.

The creatures created by the machine are pieced together similarly to Frankenstein. The machine can scan multiple people and generate a new person based on the desired elements of the people scanned. I use the machine to try and create a superhuman, but shortly afterwards I wake up.
